# One-tile fixture

`one-tile.pmtiles` is copied without modification from the pre-cleanup
repository's `src/domains/tile-resolver/__fixtures__/test_fixture_1.pmtiles`.
Git blob: `c86db1f27bba6d3818bb5da5ac6b78e8f6e3303a`.

It contains one vector polygon in layer `test_fixture_1pmtiles` at z/x/y
`0/0/0`. It is a delivery and rendering fixture, not a geographical basemap.
Do not use its successful render to claim roads, labels, or real-world
coverage work. The archive's original external provenance is not recorded
in this repository; it is retained as an existing test artifact only.
